lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible across the mid-flank, posterior to the fifth gill slit. Spots are arranged in approximately five distinguishable horizontal rows and ten vertical columns within the primary field of view.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are discernible, intersecting the primary horizontal rows of blobs to form a rectilinear pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral flank, exhibiting a pronounced luminance gradient with lighter pixels on the superior aspect and darker shadowing on the inferior aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 8-12 low-diameter, high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered toward the leading edge and mid-section of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of smaller, non-grid-aligned high-luminance spots is visible on the cranial region, anterior to the first gill slit.
